main_text.l: Celeberrimo Oratori, operis Authori S. P.
PRima Scholæ Patriæ TIGURINÆ quæ sit origo,
Qui sint progressus, quæque incrementa, secundo
Numine quo pacto sacra hæc succreverit arbos:
Qui sint Doctores, fuerintque ex ordine longo,
Illustres famâ, celebres ultra ostia Nili,
Tam sacra pandentes, Linguas Latiam atque Pelasgam,
Hebræámque, quibus divina volumina gaudent,
Quâm Logicas artes, Physicam, atque Mathesin acutam:
Quæque Scholæ leges, quæ privilegia, jura:
Quæque coërcendi malé-sanos norma, modúsque:
Et qui Rectores fuerint à pluribus annis:
Omnia, more suo, celeberrimus HOTTINGERUS
Aoniis tincto lymphis edisserit ore.
Ista recensendo Orator vel saxa ciebat,
Attoniti steterunt omnes, avidóque biberunt
Gutture: multarum multos oblivio rerum
Ceperat, Orator lucis quas traxit in auram.
Nobile par Scholæ sunt, & Bibliotheca: proinde
Bibliotheca Scholæ juncta est, Thuricensia scripta
In medium profert, in apricum sistit, ut inde
Ante oculos rutilent Tigurini sydera Cœli,
Authorésque graves, quorum celeberrima scripta
Illustrem reddunt orbem, ceu Phœbus Olympum.
O Tigurina tibi tanto de Præsīde gaude,
Plaude Schola, & super hoc canta Rectore triumphum.
O Tigurina juventa Deo fer thura precésque,
Tam pro Rectoris, quàm Gymnasiique salute.
At Tu, magne Deus, celsi Moderator Olympi,
Esto Scholæ nostræ perpes Moderator in ævum.
Mense Octobri, Anno,
SCHOLAM Patriæ Int Vere DeVs gratiosè.
Ejúsque Rector vivat & floreat
CLarissIMVs D. HottIngerVs.
FELIX WYSSIUS,
Pastor Abbatissanus in Ecclesia Tigurina.

page.notes: Printed in a mixture of roman and italic type; the signature block is set in small capitals and partly in italic. Some letters in the scan are uncertain, notably in "Nobile par", "Tigurini" and the final signature lines. The mark at the top of the page is a stray dot, not transcribed.
